description: Draft research method; unqualified and not published.

routing.when_to_use: The user asks to fit, validate, compare, or interpret a supervised/unsupervised model, including time-series forecasting or classification.
when_not_to_use: Do not use outside the task-specific scope described in SKILL.md.

required_inputs.name: request
required_inputs.description: Prediction or learning target; data and provenance; observation unit, feature timing, target horizon, train/test chronology or groups, leakage risks, deployment decision, baseline, evaluation metric and constraints.

expected_outputs.name: deliverables
expected_outputs.description: Task framing and data checks; baseline and validation design; preprocessing/model pipeline; appropriate metrics and uncertainty; leakage and generalization risks; reproducible findings and limits.

forbidden_actions: Treat model outputs as predictive or descriptive unless a causal design supports causality. No live trading or business action.

Do not claim evaluation, certification, admission, release, or publication from this draft.
verification_steps: Check method fit and source traceability.
Check explicit gaps, limits, assumptions, and owner boundaries.
Confirm no fabricated PASS, certification, or external action.
completion_criteria: Requested draft deliverables are present or missing inputs are named.

known_limitations: The task-specific source set and method supports have not been admitted for release.
